note: The first fuzz byte controls how the command stream is parsed and whether the FLAC payload is supplied via stdin or a temp file.
When stdin is not used, the remaining bytes are written to a temporary file and passed to the flac tool for parsing.
The picture description field is returned directly; for malformed picture metadata this field can remain uninitialized and MSan reports a use-of-uninitialized-value when it is read.
